sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा ।उवाच धर्मसहितं हनुमन्तं यशस्विनी ।। ६.११६.३८ ।।
transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā ।uvāca dharmasahitaṁ hanumantaṁ yaśasvinī ।। 6.116.38 ।।

translations.english: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."
